mechanism.proposal: Project a completed local KV-partition attention state before the complete attention merge.
mechanism.causal_input: Actual current query, matching depth/layer KV partition, local normalized head output, and Wo head block.
mechanism.concurrent_unit: A ready head/partition projection while other head/partition attention tasks remain incomplete.
mechanism.ownership: Direct plan keeps sequence-partitioned KV and complete Wo at each sequence worker. Other layouts need separate complete accounting.
mechanism.preserved: Q/K/V projections, RoPE, historical KV contents, request/depth/layer identities, original gates and publication semantics.
mechanism.barrier: Global partition weights differ by head. A single scalar merge after head mixing is generally invalid.
mechanism.valid_real_arithmetic_path: Retain projected vectors separately by head, then apply the actual per-head global coefficients.
mechanism.charged_direct_costs: 16-fold vector-state expansion, S-fold aggregate Wo contractions and replicas, query/current-KV distribution, state merges, scratch, and synchronization.
mechanism.BF16_scope: Removing the native merged-attention BF16 cast changes the deterministic control. Model quality remains NOT_RUN.
mechanism.not_an_impossibility_theorem: Invertible Wo permits a dense change-of-basis merge. The positive control demonstrates that route. This audit does not claim all compact representations fail.
mechanism.verdict: Reject cheap mixed-state scalar merge. Valid completed-head streaming remains generic engineering. No engine or new card.
mechanism.changed_fact_for_reopening: A specified representation or ownership plan removes the named costs under a matched numerical contract and beats relevant same-P controls.
